mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an imminent monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 in a given month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand growth, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a contraction in real economic output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 250.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases equity risk premia and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0 and 12-month growth exceeds 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and weak residential investment (HOUST) signals a demand-side imbalance where aggregate demand is outpacing supply capacity, increasing inflation risk and prompting monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.8% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 3.8 and PAYEMS > 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 107.0 for two consecutive months, combined with rising input costs (CPIAUCSL), indicates a supply-side shock that reduces corporate profitability and increases uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 107.0 for two consecutive months and CPIAUCSL is rising (t-test p > 0.05).
